latest.title: Zohran Mamdani | This Past Weekend w/ Theo Von #687
latest.desc:
Zohran Mamdani is the 112th Mayor of New York City. He was previously a housing advocate and member of the New York State Assembly.

Mayor Mamdani joins Theo to discuss overall mayoral stuff, catching strays from world leaders, and if the American Dream still exists.
